import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Survival by passenger class and gender
survival_pclass_gender = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack()
survival_pclass_gender_percent = survival_pclass_gender.div(survival_pclass_gender.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_pclass_gender_percent.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class & Gender', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class\nMale', '1st Class\nFemale', 
                     '2nd Class\nMale', '2nd Class\nFemale',
                     '3rd Class\nMale', '3rd Class\nFemale'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.histplot(data=df, x='age', hue='survived', bins=30, kde=True, ax=ax2, 
             palette=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], alpha=0.6)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival.values * 100, 
               color=['#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22'])
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
             f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 4. Fare distribution by passenger class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='pclass', y='fare', hue='survived', ax=ax4, 
            palette=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], showfliers=False)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class and Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_yscale('log')
ax4.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival Status')
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])

# 5. Family size impact on survival
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
df['family_category'] = pd.cut(df['family_size'], 
                               bins=[0, 1, 4, 11], 
                               labels=['Alone', 'Small Family', 'Large Family'])

family_survival = df.groupby('family_category')['survived'].mean().sort_values()
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
bars = ax5.bar(family_survival.index, family_survival.values * 100, 
               color=['#e74c3c', '#f39c12', '#2ecc71'])
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size Category', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
             f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 6. Survival rate by age group and gender
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], 
                         bins=[0, 12, 18, 35, 60, 100], 
                         labels=['Child', 'Teen', 'Young Adult', 'Adult', 'Senior'])
age_gender_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()

ax6 = axes[1, 2]
x = np.arange(len(age_gender_survival.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax6.bar(x - width/2, age_gender_survival['male'].values * 100, width, 
                label='Male', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax6.bar(x + width/2, age_gender_survival['female'].values * 100, width, 
                label='Female', color='#e84393', alpha=0.8)

ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Age Group and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_xticks(x)
ax6.set_xticklabels(age_gender_survival.index)
ax6.legend()
ax6.set_ylim(0, 100)

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        if not np.isnan(height):
            ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
                    f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
